title: Zechariah Chapter 14 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Zechariah chapter 14 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Zechariah Chapter 14 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Zechariah Chapter 14.

questions.question: What will happen to the spoil when the day of the LORD comes?
options: It shall be divided in the midst of thee
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be divided in the midst of thee
questions.explanation: The spoil will be divided in the midst of the people as stated in Zechariah 14:1.

questions.question: Who will gather all nations against Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The LORD is the one who will gather all nations against Jerusalem as mentioned in Zechariah 14:2.

questions.question: What shall happen to the houses in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The houses in Jerusalem shall be rifled, as stated in Zechariah 14:2.

questions.question: What will the LORD do against the nations?
questions.explanation: The LORD will go forth and fight against those nations, as mentioned in Zechariah 14:3.

questions.question: Where will the LORD's feet stand in that day?
questions.explanation: The LORD's feet shall stand upon the mount of Olives, as stated in Zechariah 14:4.

questions.question: True or False: Half of the city will go forth into captivity.
questions.explanation: It is true that half of the city shall go forth into captivity, as stated in Zechariah 14:2.

questions.question: What will happen to the light on that day?
options: It will not be clear, nor dark
questions.correctAnswer: It will not be clear, nor dark
questions.explanation: On that day, the light shall not be clear, nor dark, according to Zechariah 14:6.

questions.question: True or False: In that day, it shall be one day known to the LORD.
questions.explanation: It is true that it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, as mentioned in Zechariah 14:7.

questions.question: What will go out from Jerusalem in that day?
questions.explanation: Living waters shall go out from Jerusalem, as described in Zechariah 14:8.

questions.question: True or False: The LORD will be king over all the earth in that day.
questions.explanation: It is true that the LORD shall be king over all the earth in that day, as stated in Zechariah 14:9.

questions.question: In Zechariah 14, which event occurs first?
options: The day of the LORD cometh
questions.correctAnswer: The day of the LORD cometh
questions.explanation: The chapter begins with the proclamation that the day of the LORD cometh, as stated in Zechariah 14:1.

questions.question: What will happen to the flesh of those who fought against Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, according to Zechariah 14:12.

questions.question: What will there be no more in the house of the LORD?
questions.explanation: There shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts, as stated in Zechariah 14:21.

questions.question: True or False: The family of Egypt will be punished if they do not come to keep the feast of tabernacles.
questions.explanation: It is true that the family of Egypt will face punishment if they do not come up to keep the feast of tabernacles, as indicated in Zechariah 14:18.

questions.question: What shall be upon the bells of the horses in that day?
questions.explanation: In that day, there shall be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD, as stated in Zechariah 14:20.

medium.title: Zechariah Chapter 14 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Zechariah Chapter 14 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What will happen to Jerusalem according to Zechariah 14:2?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:2 states that 'the city shall be taken,' indicating a time of conflict and turmoil for Jerusalem.

questions.question: According to Zechariah 14:4, where will the LORD's feet stand?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:4 clearly states that 'his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives.'

questions.question: What will happen in the valley of the mountains according to Zechariah 14:5?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:5 indicates that 'ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains,' suggesting an escape during a time of crisis.

questions.question: What does Zechariah 14:9 say about the LORD's reign?
options: He will be king over all the earth
He will only be king of Judah
He will rule from Mount Sinai
questions.correctAnswer: He will be king over all the earth
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:9 proclaims that 'the LORD shall be king over all the earth,' emphasizing His universal authority.

questions.question: According to Zechariah 14:11, what will be the state of Jerusalem?
options: It will be rebuilt with gold
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:11 assures that 'Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited,' indicating restoration and peace.

questions.question: What does Zechariah 14:12 describe as the plague for those who fought against Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:12 details a devastating plague where 'Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet.'

questions.question: What will happen to the nations that do not come up to worship the King according to Zechariah 14:17?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:17 specifies that 'upon them shall be no rain' if they do not come up to worship the King.

questions.question: What is the significance of the living waters mentioned in Zechariah 14:8?
options: They are a sign of warfare
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:8 describes living waters flowing from Jerusalem, symbolizing life and prosperity in the land.

questions.question: In Zechariah 14:10, what will happen to the land from Geba to Rimmon?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:10 states that 'the land shall be turned as a plain... and it shall be lifted up,' indicating a transformation of the terrain.

questions.question: True or False: Zechariah 14:6 states that the light will be clear and bright on that day.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:6 indicates that 'the light shall not be clear, nor dark,' suggesting an unusual light on that day.

questions.question: True or False: According to Zechariah 14:18, Egypt will face a plague if it does not come up to worship.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:18 states that if Egypt does not come up, 'there shall be the plague,' confirming the consequences of disobedience.

questions.question: True or False: Zechariah 14:14 mentions that Judah will not fight in Jerusalem.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:14 states, 'Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem,' indicating their involvement in the conflict.

hard.title: Zechariah Chapter 14 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Zechariah Chapter 14.

questions.question: What shall be the plague of the horse, mule, camel, and all beasts in those tents?
questions.explanation: The verse states that the plague will be as it is described in Zechariah 14:15, indicating a consuming away of flesh.

questions.question: What will happen to those who do not come up to Jerusalem to worship the King?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:17 states that those who do not come to worship the King will not receive rain.

questions.question: In Zechariah 14:16, what are the nations expected to do yearly?
options: Worship the King and keep the feast of tabernacles
questions.correctAnswer: Worship the King and keep the feast of tabernacles
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:16 indicates that the nations left after the battle will go up to worship the King and keep the feast.

questions.question: The pots in the Lord's house will be like what in that day?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:20 describes the pots in the Lord's house being like the bowls before the altar, symbolizing holiness.

questions.question: In Zechariah 14:18, what will happen to Egypt if they do not go up to Jerusalem?
options: They will be punished with a plague
questions.correctAnswer: They will be punished with a plague
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:18 states that if Egypt does not go up, there shall be a plague upon them.

questions.question: What does Zechariah 14:8 say will go out from Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:8 indicates that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, flowing towards both seas.

questions.question: True or False: In that day, there shall be no more utter destruction in Jerusalem.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:11 states that men shall dwell in Jerusalem, and there shall be no more utter destruction.

questions.question: What shall be upon the bells of the horses in that day?
questions.explanation: According to Zechariah 14:20, the bells on the horses will declare 'HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD.'

questions.question: True or False: The name of the Lord will be one in that day according to Zechariah 14:9.
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:9 confirms that there shall be one Lord and His name shall be one.

questions.question: What does Zechariah 14:14 say Judah will do at Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:14 states that Judah shall fight at Jerusalem, indicating active resistance.

questions.question: Which other biblical passage connects with the theme of nations coming to Jerusalem to worship?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 2:2-3 speaks of all nations flowing to the mountain of the Lord's house, echoing Zechariah 14:16's theme of nations worshipping in Jerusalem.

questions.question: What literary device is used in Zechariah 14:17 regarding the punishment for not coming to worship?
questions.explanation: The concept of rain as a blessing and its absence as a curse symbolizes the relationship between worship and divine favor, as seen in Zechariah 14:17.

questions.question: What will happen to the Canaanite in the house of the Lord of hosts according to Zechariah 14:21?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 14:21 states there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the Lord of hosts, indicating a complete removal.

theological.title: Zechariah Chapter 14 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Zechariah Chapter 14 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What shall happen to the nations that gather against Jerusalem according to Zechariah 14?
options: They will be defeated by the LORD
They will be welcomed into Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: They will be defeated by the LORD
questions.explanation: The text states that the LORD will go forth and fight against those nations, indicating their defeat (Zechariah 14:3).

questions.question: What is signified by the LORD standing on the mount of Olives?
options: A new kingdom will be established
questions.explanation: The verse describes how the mount of Olives shall cleave, forming a great valley, signifying a significant event in Jerusalem's future (Zechariah 14:4).

questions.question: What nature of light is described in Zechariah 14:6?
options: It will be bright and clear
It will be dark all day
It will not be clear nor dark
questions.correctAnswer: It will not be clear nor dark
questions.explanation: The verse specifically states that the light shall not be clear nor dark, indicating an extraordinary day (Zechariah 14:6).

questions.question: According to Zechariah 14:8, what will flow from Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The verse mentions that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem, indicating a divine blessing and renewal (Zechariah 14:8).

questions.question: What does Zechariah 14:9 reveal about the LORD's authority?
options: He will be king over some nations
He will be king over all the earth
He will share kingship with others
questions.correctAnswer: He will be king over all the earth
questions.explanation: The verse clearly states that the LORD shall be king over all the earth, emphasizing His sovereignty (Zechariah 14:9).

questions.question: What will happen to Jerusalem according to Zechariah 14:11?
options: It will be a desolate wasteland
It will be rebuilt in a different location
questions.explanation: The verse declares that Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited, indicating restoration and protection (Zechariah 14:11).

questions.question: What does the plague mentioned in Zechariah 14:12 signify?
questions.explanation: The verse describes a plague that will smite those who fought against Jerusalem, indicating divine judgment (Zechariah 14:12).

questions.question: What is the significance of the feast of tabernacles in Zechariah 14:16?
options: It is a festival of mourning
It is no longer to be celebrated
It is a time of judgment
questions.explanation: The feast of tabernacles commemorates God's provision and presence, and all nations are called to worship during it (Zechariah 14:16).

questions.question: What will happen to those who do not go to Jerusalem as mentioned in Zechariah 14:17?
options: They will be punished with famine
questions.correctAnswer: They will be punished with famine
questions.explanation: The text states that those who do not come to worship will face a lack of rain, indicating punishment (Zechariah 14:17).

questions.question: What does Zechariah 14:20 state about the bells of the horses?
options: They will have inscriptions of peace
They will be marked HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD
questions.correctAnswer: They will be marked HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD
questions.explanation: The verse notes that the bells of the horses will be inscribed with 'HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD', symbolizing sanctification (Zechariah 14:20).

questions.question: According to Zechariah 14:18, what will happen to Egypt if they do not come up to worship?
questions.explanation: The text indicates that if Egypt does not come up to worship, they will experience a plague, showing the seriousness of worshiping the LORD (Zechariah 14:18).

questions.question: What combined teaching do Zechariah 14:10 and 14:11 convey about the restoration of the land?
options: The land will be lifted up and safely inhabited
The land will be under foreign control
questions.correctAnswer: The land will be lifted up and safely inhabited
questions.explanation: These verses together show that the land will undergo transformation and will be a place of safety (Zechariah 14:10-11).

questions.question: What attribute of God is demonstrated in Zechariah 14:3 when He fights for Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The act of the LORD fighting for Jerusalem highlights His absolute sovereignty over nations and events (Zechariah 14:3).

questions.question: What does Zechariah 14:7 imply about the nature of the coming day of the LORD?
options: It will be an ordinary day
It will be a day of confusion
It will be unique and not like normal days
It will be a day of judgment only
questions.correctAnswer: It will be unique and not like normal days
questions.explanation: The verse indicates that this day will not be categorized as day or night, underscoring its uniqueness (Zechariah 14:7).

questions.question: What doctrinal insight can be drawn from combining Zechariah 14:9 and 14:21 concerning God’s kingship?
options: God will only be king of Israel
God's holiness will be evident in all aspects of life
God's reign will be limited to Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: God's holiness will be evident in all aspects of life
questions.explanation: The combination of God's kingship and the declaration of holiness in all pots signifies the pervasive nature of His holiness (Zechariah 14:9, 21).
